==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology 1===
From Late {{inh|en|enm|representacioun}}, from {{der|en|fro|representacion}}, from {{der|en|la|repraesentātiō}}. {{surf|en|represent|-ation}}.

====Alternative forms====
* {{l|en|repræsentation}} {{qualifier|archaic}}

====Pronunciation====
* {{rhymes|en|eɪʃən|s=5}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˌɹɛp.ɹə.zɛnˈteɪ.ʃən/}}
* {{audio|en|En-us-representation.ogg|a=US}}

====Noun====
{{en-noun|~}}

# That which [[represent]]s something else.
#: {{ux|en|The [[w:Venus of Willendorf|Venus of Willendorf]] was an early '''representation''' of the female body.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|date=8 October 2012|author=Daniel W. Patterson|publisher=UNC Press Books|isbn=9780807837535|title=The True Image: Gravestone Art and the Culture of Scotch Irish Settlers in the Pennsylvania and Carolina Backcountry|url=https://books.google.co.nz/books?id=s7dGj3J_1cgC|page=141|text=The second and third quarters of the shield are indecipherable on the stone but clearer in two other '''representations''' of the arms, a painted wooden funeral hatchment for Mary Davie{{...}}}}
#* {{quote-web
|en
|date=April 10, 2023
|author=Sarah Wu; Yew Lun Tian; Fabian Hamacher; Yimou Lee
|title=A punch in the face for Xi caricature: Taiwan air force badge goes viral
|editor=Gareth Jones
|work=w:Reuters
|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20230410110424/https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/punch-face-xi-caricature-taiwan-air-force-badge-goes-viral-2023-04-10/
|archivedate=10 April 2023
|url=https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/punch-face-xi-caricature-taiwan-air-force-badge-goes-viral-2023-04-10/
|text=Chinese censors have long targeted '''representations''' of Winnie the Pooh - created by British author A.A. Milne - over internet memes that compare the fictional bear to China's president.}}
# The act of representing.
#: {{ux|en|We are no longer happy with your '''representation''' of our company at trade events.}}
# {{lb|en|by extension|uncountable}} The appearance(s) of a particular demographic group in a piece of media, particularly in regards to how such appearances are treated.
# {{lb|en|legal}} The [[lawyer]]s and [[staff]] who argue on behalf of another in court.
#: {{ux|en|People who cannot afford '''representation''' are eligible for government assistance.}}
# {{lb|en|politics}} The ability to elect a [[representative]] to speak on one's behalf in [[government]]; the role of this representative in government.
#: {{ux|en|The lack of '''representation''' in the British parliament was one of the main factors behind the American Revolution.}}
# {{lb|en|mathematics}} An [[action]] of some [[algebraic structure]] (typically a [[group]] or [[algebra]], particularly a [[Lie algebra]]) on a [[vector space]], such that each [[element]] acts by a [[linear]] [[endomorphism]].
# A [[figure]], image or idea that [[substitute]]s reality.
# A [[theatrical]] performance.
# {{rfv-sense|en}} A [[statement]]; a presentation of opinion or position, or an [[utterance]] made to influence the opinions or actions of others.
#: {{ux|en|Residents of the area made '''representations''' to the authorities for the chemical plant to be investigated for illegally dumping waste into the stream.}}
